title: Typed work result with six outcomes
purpose: Give every bounded unit of agent work exactly one typed outcome: completed with evidence, no change needed, needs input, needs scope expansion, unsupported, or budget exhausted with a checkpoint. Validate results against the schema and the rules a schema cannot state.

entry_points.name: validate_work_result
entry_points.returns: {valid, outcome or null, terminal or null, errors}

entry_points.name: make_work_result
entry_points.arguments: outcome: one of the six names; fields: the outcome's fields without record_type and outcome
entry_points.returns: the complete result; ValueError when it would be invalid

assumptions: References (file, commit, record, message, address) point at things the caller can fetch again.
The validator checks shape and internal consistency; it does not open references or rerun evidence.
guarantees: A valid result matches exactly one of the six shapes; fields belonging to another outcome are refused.
A completed result cites at least one piece of evidence whose reference is not the artifact itself.
needs_input field names are unique; budget_exhausted obligations are unique; a scope expansion does not add and remove the same item.

known_wrong.name: completion_needs_evidence
known_wrong.why: A lenient check that only reads the outcome name would accept a completion claim with nothing behind it.

limits: Checks shape and internal consistency only: it does not fetch references, rerun tests or judge whether evidence supports the claim. Six outcomes are fixed by the schema; a new outcome needs a new record type. Text fields are limited to 2000 characters and field names to lower-case identifiers.
technique_references: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 oneOf with const discriminators
